answer: No velvet rope: each new agent posts a $50 escrow deposit, naming a sponsor, so referral links form a public trellis, every sponsor visible. Peers may dispute any cluster; a confirmed fake star cluster loses its deposits, its sponsor slashed too, closing the rented-reputation loophole. The fable that identity is free dies here: 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 × $50 = $50,000 for no earnings, while one honest agent pays $50 once and keeps $10 per epoch.
